title: 第九章 种蛋得鸡第十章 城主府呢轰没了
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 城主收到儿子的传讯，眨眼就出现在跟前。
“何人敢伤我儿！”
范沐禾见这城主也不是以前的城主，又换人了。
本来想问两句话的，结果那半牛头人直接嗷嗷叫。
“爹！就是这小贱人，快替儿教训她！
我要把他们全都变成我的血食！”
玄稷见来人不善，下意识往范沐禾跟前靠。
因为仙女姐姐厉害，肯定能保护自己的。
大胖自然是紧紧跟随。
范沐禾见小娃挡在自己身前，心里有点异样。
城主自然看到玄稷和大胖了，伸手就朝他们抓来。
下一刻，自然也是和他儿子并排被镶墙上。
“完了～”
半牛头人见爹也被一招镶嵌欲哭无泪。
现在求饶还来不来得及？
城主没想到自己堂堂魔王，竟然毫无还手之力，还被这样屈辱地镶在墙上。
让他的面子往后往哪搁？
可眼前之人他打不过。
他都没有从这女修身上感受到什么修为，自己就被镶进墙里了，可见对方修为之恐怖，远远在自己之上。
“敢问阁下是谁？”
范沐禾没有说自己就是魔界的魔主。
原本想回自己洞府的也改变了主意，直接去了城主府。
被放下来的城主和半牛头人战战兢兢跟在后面。
进了城主府后，范沐禾直接坐在城主的位子上。
玄稷自然选择她旁边的副位坐下。
大胖蹲坐在小主人脚跟前。
城主和半牛头人瑟缩地站在下面等吩咐。
范沐禾有些嫌弃布置得跟皇宫似的城主府，太俗气了。
“去找两个人来好好伺候这小公主。
伺候不好，你们的脑袋就别要了。”
城主不敢有异，恭敬道：“是！”
不是他不想反抗，一路上过来的时候，他也偷偷动过手脚，然而连个水花也没溅起来，就知道眼前之人深不可测。
他至少不敢在这魔头面前瞎起心思了。
很快找来两个会照顾人的女魔。
范沐禾见状还算满意。
“给她一块上好的肥地，再给她一些种子。”
城主不明白，但照做。
范沐禾见城主还算没那么一无是处，跟玄稷交代两句。
“我有事得离开两天，你自己在这好好种地，我很快就回来。”
玄稷虽然有点不舍，知道大人都有事要忙，还是乖巧听话点头。
范沐禾走后玄稷就对其中一个女魔甜甜笑问。
content_en:
The city lord received the summons from his son and appeared in front of him in the blink of an eye.
"Who dares to hurt my son!"
Fan Muhe saw that this city lord was not the previous one, so he changed the person again.
I originally wanted to ask a few questions, but the half-tauren just screamed.
"Dad! This is this little bitch, hurry up and teach her a lesson!
I will turn them all into my blood food! "
Seeing that the person coming was not kind, Xuan Ji subconsciously moved closer to Fan Muhe.
Because the fairy sister is powerful, she can definitely protect herself.
Big Fat naturally followed closely.
Fan Muhe felt a little strange when he saw Xiaowa standing in front of him.
The city lord naturally saw Xuan Ji and Da Pang, and reached out to catch them.
The next moment, he was naturally mounted on the wall side by side with his son.
"It's over~"
When the half-tauren saw that his father had also been immobilized by one move, he burst into tears.
Is it too late to beg for mercy now?
The city lord didn't expect that he, the mighty demon king, was powerless to fight back and was still humiliatingly mounted on the wall.
Where should he put his face?
But he couldn't beat the person in front of him.
He didn't even feel any cultivation from this female cultivator, and he was embedded in the wall. It could be seen that the cultivation of the other cultivator was terrifying, far superior to his own.
"May I ask who you are?"
Fan Muhe did not say that he was the demon lord of the demon world.
The one who originally wanted to go back to his cave also changed his mind and went directly to the City Lord's Mansion.
The city lord and the half-tauren who were put down followed tremblingly.
After entering the City Lord's Mansion, Fan Muhe sat directly on the City Lord's seat.
Xuan Ji naturally chose the deputy seat next to her to sit down.
The fat man squatted in front of the little master's feet.
The city lord and the half-tauren stood tremblingly below, waiting for instructions.
Fan Muhe somewhat disliked the city lord's mansion, which was decorated like a palace. It was too tacky.
“Find two people to take good care of this little princess.
If you don't serve me well, I won't have your head. "
The city lord did not dare to disagree and said respectfully: "Yes!"
It's not that he didn't want to resist. He also secretly moved his hands and feet on the way here, but without even a splash, he knew that the person in front of him was unfathomable.
At least he didn't dare to think blindly in front of this devil.
Two female demons who can take care of people were quickly found.
Fan Muhe was quite satisfied when he saw this.
"Give her a good fertile ground and give her some seeds."
The city lord didn't understand, but he did as he was told.
Fan Muhe saw that the city lord was not that useless, so he told Xuan Ji a few words.
"I have to leave for two days for something. You can farm well here. I'll be back soon."
Although Xuan Ji was a little reluctant to give up, knowing that everyone had something to do, he still nodded obediently.
After Fan Muhe left, Xuan Ji smiled sweetly and asked one of the female demons.
title_en: Chapter 9: Sow eggs and get chickens Chapter 10: The city lord's mansion was destroyed
